media.title: Times Union, 22 July 1936 — We Went to College Rialto notice
media.description: Press clipping from Times Union, 22 July 1936, p. 4, announcing MGM’s We Went to College at the Rialto Theatre. It credits special music to Bronislau Kaper, Walter Jurmann and Gus Kohn [sic] and names the songs “We Went to College,” “Alma Mater,” and “Sutter’s Victory March.”
media.altText: Newspaper clipping from Times Union, 22 July 1936.
